column18: There were no matches between the teams as they each played at different divisions. For the 1989–90 season, Barcelona B was relegated to 2ªB, followed a year later by Real Madrid B for the 1990–91 season. Both teams returned to 2ª for the 1991–92 season.

After the 1996–97 season, both teams were relegated to 2ªB. During the following seasons, there were no matches between them as they each played at different divisions, each having returned to 2ª at different moments in the past, but never together. Both teams met again for the first time during the 2nd round of the 2012–13 season.

There were no matches between the teams as they each played at different divisions. For the 2014–15 season, Real Madrid B was relegated to 2ªB, followed a year later by Barcelona B for the 2015–16 season.  During the following seasons, there were no matches between them as they each played at different divisions or groups. Both teams met again for the first time in the third tier under the new Spanish football league system for the 2021–22.
